kitDescription: Dorothy is a Burst I Water Supporter whose main team contribution is rotation speed: every time she empties her 60-round magazine she cuts all allies' Burst Skill cooldowns by 1.56 seconds, letting the whole team reach Full Burst faster. Her Skill 2, Scorch to Dust, periodically blasts all enemies for 216% of her final ATK as distributed damage on a 20-second internal cooldown. Her burst puts her into Manifestation for 10 seconds: she gains Pierce, her Skill 2 cooldown is slashed by 18 seconds so it fires much more often during the window, and while Manifestation lasts her last-bullet shots also grant the team +50.68% damage to parts for 5 seconds. The burst also Brands a designated enemy, accumulating all damage the team deals to it over 10 seconds and then re-dealing that total (capped at 8900.83% of her final ATK) to all enemies as distributed damage. In practice the Brand cap is far below what a normal team deals in 10 seconds, so Brand effectively always pays out its full cap as one large delayed nuke that lands inside her own Full Burst window.

verdictRationale: No undocumented divergences exist: all six kit lines are FAITHFUL (S1 burst-CDR, S2 Scorch, Gain Pierce, Brand) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (Manifestation S2-CDR, the S1-L2 Manifestation gate). Ranked: the one material gap is the Manifestation S2-CDR (med, ~+1080% distributed per burst window under-credited), and it is a primitive absence all three agents independently confirmed — not a driver error; the S1-L2 gate and Brand at-cap residuals are low-severity and documented. Convergence is strong in both directions: the S5 blind tests run GREEN unmodified against the shipped override (14 pass, 3 self-declared GAP skips, 0 fail), the S6 blind override is block-identical on all five modeled lines, and the cross-family S2b reviewer independently derived the hardest encoding (Brand at-cap delaySec:10 landing inside her own FB) plus its instant-at-cast discriminant before seeing the driver's work. Discrimination holds everywhere: D1 rotation-schedule vs CDR-stripped, D3 cadence (interval 10/40) + distributed-flavor probe, D4 timed-vs-permanent pierce probe, D6 delayed-vs-instant FB-major — every load-bearing test fails under its named nearest-wrong model, and the fixture trap (Burst I unit vacuous in the carry slot) was avoided via a custom comp asserting dorothyBursts > 0. Same-model residuals the owner should spot-check: (1) Brand's cap-binds claim rests on the sim's OWN team-damage totals (~98M vs ~29M), an internal quantity never validated against a real Dorothy fight; (2) the S2 first-fire phase (t=20) is the standing ⚑ interval convention; (3) the S1 burst-CDR's real-world rotation effect has no popup-level anchor — it is validated only through the sim's own chain arithmetic. None of these block GO; all are flagged in the artifacts.
